meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 GitHub 接成聊天渠道,以机器人账号参与 PR 和 issue 的评论线程;被 @ 时会在对应讨论串里回复,首个 @ 之后还会继续跟进后续评论。
howto.when: 当有人在已配置仓库的 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人账号时触发;首次 @ 后该评论线程被订阅,后续评论也会自动处理。

say.text: @我的机器人 请回复这条 PR 评论里的问题
say.note: 机器人会在该评论线程中回复你。

say.text: @我的机器人 在 issue 里告诉我下一步该做什么
say.note: 会以机器人账号在 issue 评论中回复。

say.text: @我的机器人 继续跟进这个讨论串的后续评论
say.note: 首次 @ 之后,该线程会被订阅并持续回复。

howto.what_en: Adds GitHub as a chat channel through the Chat SDK. The bot account joins PR and issue comment threads and replies when @-mentioned; after the first mention the thread is subscribed and follow-up comments also get responses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment on a configured repo (webhooks must be set up); after the first mention the comment thread stays subscribed.

say_en.text: @my-bot please reply to this PR comment question
say_en.note: The bot replies in that comment thread.

say_en.text: @my-bot tell me the next step in this issue
say_en.note: Replies as the bot account in the issue.
The thread stays subscribed after the first mention.
